resetPassword.heading: Password Recovery
resetPassword.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your Askedly account.
resetPassword.ignore: If you did not request a password reset, please ignore this email.
resetPassword.instruction: To reset your password, click the button below:
resetPassword.copyLink: Or copy and paste the link below into your browser:
resetPassword.expiry: This link is valid for 1 hour. After that, you will need to request a new password reset.
